associations.title: Attribuer le premier point et chaque point de niveau côté serveur
associations.finding: Spawn level1/ranks0 and server XP level increases imply available points=level-sum(ranks) for four supported champions. Native XP thresholds are inputs; no explicit point allocator or special grant table is consumed.
associations.remaining: Qualify first/free grants,all champions,multilevel gains and native server point accounting.

associations.title: Empêcher la dépense d’un point non disponible
associations.finding: next_rank rejects when sum(ranks)>=level before learn mutates ranks; invalid slots and unsupported champions refuse.
associations.remaining: Qualify malformed snapshots,all schemes and atomic resource invariants.

associations.title: Refuser une double dépense concurrente du même point
associations.finding: Learning uses serial mutable Simulation command,validates before one rank assignment; authenticated session input is committed before dispatch. These are actual gates,not a live concurrent exactly-once proof.
associations.remaining: Exercise duplicated/reordered/concurrent input and every legacy/session route without double spending.

associations.title: Refuser un apprentissage envoyé pour un autre joueur
associations.finding: Learn carries only slot;session host passes accepted.context.player to Simulation.command. Caller identity is authoritative in this route.
associations.remaining: Qualify spoofed/malformed contexts,legacy paths and all transport ownership gates.

associations.title: Conserver les points non dépensés pendant la reconnexion
associations.finding: Resume rebinds the existing session/player and installs its clock recipient without joining a new Champion. Implicit remaining points stay in existing level/ranks,not a separate counter.
associations.remaining: Qualify expiry,epoch changes,death,server restart and persistence boundaries;source inspection is not a reconnect scenario.

associations.title: Appliquer les limites de rang selon le niveau du champion
associations.finding: Four supported champions use next_rank<=5 and gate2*rank-1;HUD eligibility calls that same core gate. Native SpellsUpLevels fields are absent for these four queries,not evidence for fabricated defaults.
associations.remaining: Recover/qualify native default rank table and actual loader/server use;cover every champion.
